text: {soft} So... was it all for nothing? (beat) No. Because the thing that changed most... was never on the scale. In twenty eleven, scientists in the US had a hundred and twenty older adults walk for a year. Then they scanned their brains. The hippocampus, the part that makes your memories... had grown about two percent. In the group that only stretched... it shrank. {wonder} The walkers had turned back one to two years of brain ageing.
